title: Causal training consequences of GRPO semantic non-conformance

theory_gate.reason: Verifier false negatives, format sensitivity, and dynamic secondary verification are occupied by prior work; the action-reversal bound is retained only as motivation.

central_question: Do the material native-versus-intended objective semantics discovered in S1 change gradient direction and short-run learning under matched generated-token and FLOP budgets, or are they harmless rescalings?

hypotheses.H0: After matching generated tokens, optimizer settings, and active completions, native and intended semantics differ only numerically or by a scalar that does not change normalized gradient direction or held-out learning-curve AUC.
hypotheses.H1: Completion-selection and reduction semantics change per-example weighting, producing a reproducible gradient-direction difference and a corresponding learning-curve difference in the filtered variable-length regime.
hypotheses.H2: The reward-standardization epsilon alone is practically equivalent to the intended implementation at the prespecified gradient and learning margins.
hypotheses.H3: The S1 fixture classification prospectively predicts a regime interaction: equivalence in the balanced equal-length control and material divergence in the filtered variable-length regime.

falsifiers: Native and intended normalized gradients are equivalent in the positive-control regime.
Any loss difference collapses to a constant scalar with cosine similarity inside the negative-control margin.
The gradient discrepancy does not yield a direction-consistent held-out AUC difference across all three screening seeds.
The epsilon-only ablation is as large as the reduction-only ablation, invalidating the prespecified causal attribution.
Matched token or FLOP accounting cannot be verified from immutable run records.

execution_contract.preflight: One non-scientific A100 job must resolve the exact stack, load the frozen model revision, generate one balanced eight-candidate group, compute old log-probabilities, profile positive FLOPs for policy forward, selected optimizer backward, and intended/native diagnostic backward, and apply one intended_full update. It writes no W&B or Hugging Face evidence. Failure blocks all six corpus jobs and all 24 scientific units.
execution_contract.corpora: One immutable corpus per regime and screening seed; all four conditions consume the same ordered corpus and initial adapter state.
execution_contract.matched_budget_horizon_rule: Each corpus must contain exactly 100 accepted prompt groups. Every generated candidate token is charged, including the eight unused candidates in the filtered 16-candidate pool. The complete corpus ledger is conservatively charged identically to each of its four condition runs. A corpus that cannot satisfy all 100 groups within 819200 generated tokens is infrastructure-invalid and blocks the matched four-condition block; it is not shortened or used as evidence.

train_split.balanced_equal_length: openai/gsm8k main train, all 7473 rows eligible

train_order_hash.algorithm: datasets 4.8.4 plus numpy 2.2.6 Generator(PCG64(seed)).permutation over eligible integer row indices; first 100 rows; SHA-256 over canonical JSONL with position, source index, and bound prompt/answer fields

heldout_split.balanced_equal_length: openai/gsm8k main test indices 0..127 in source order
heldout_split.filtered_variable_length: HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500 test indices 0..127 in source order

execution_contract.selection_mask_algorithm: Balanced: keep all eight rows, right-pad with EOS to the group maximum and mark all padded optimization positions active. Filtered: generate exactly 16 candidates, choose the lexicographically first six-index subset with maximal population completion-length CV, require CV>=0.35, then add the first two unused pool indices as inactive zero-mask rows; charge all 16 candidates.

flop_counter.implementation: torch.profiler.profile with CPU and CUDA activities, record_shapes=true, with_flops=true; sum finite positive event FLOPs separately for replay generation, policy/reference forward, diagnostic backward, and optimizer backward
flop_counter.all_step_ledger: token counts, active/padded optimization tokens, CUDA elapsed time, and profiler-calibrated extrapolation are recorded for every step
flop_counter.fail_closed: Missing or zero profiler coverage for any required phase invalidates the unit as infrastructure evidence.

execution_contract.checkpoint_resume_contract: At steps 20/40/60/80/100 atomically upload adapter, optimizer, scheduler, RNG states, replay cursor, corpus fingerprint, condition state, token/FLOP ledger, and source manifest to the private unit repository. Resume only from the greatest checkpoint whose full manifest and source/corpus fingerprints match byte-for-byte; otherwise fail closed.

reward_parsers.filtered_variable_length: strict normalized final boxed-answer match; equivalent forms not credited and reported as a lower bound

conditions.intended_full: Canonical S1 DAPO advantages, selected-row removal, per-completion reduction, and token-level importance ratio with asymmetric 0.2/0.28 clipping.
conditions.native_trl: Unmodified pinned TRL 1.2.0 DAPO advantage and global-active-token loss semantics.
conditions.epsilon_only: TRL sample_std+1e-4 reward scaling with canonical selected-row and per-completion reduction.
conditions.reduction_only: Canonical selected-row advantages with native zero-masked-row inclusion and DAPO global-active-token reduction.

balanced_equal_length.dataset_split: main/train for replay and main/test[0:128] for held-out
balanced_equal_length.constraints: Equal completion token counts within each group, no controller-selected zero rows, and identical active completion count across conditions.

filtered_variable_length.dataset_split: test[128:500] for replay and test[0:128] for held-out
filtered_variable_length.constraints: Deterministic frozen selection masks zero exactly two of eight completion rows and active completion-length coefficient of variation is at least 0.35 before truncation.

matched_compute.primary_budget: fixed charged generated-token ceiling per run
matched_compute.charged_tokens: All generated completion tokens, including masked, rejected, calibration, and failed-parser completions.
matched_compute.flops: Measured generation, policy/reference forward, and backward FLOPs; report both total and per optimizer step.
frozen_fields: number and placement of optimizer updates
matched_compute.fail_closed: A run with unverifiable charged-token or FLOP accounting is infrastructure-invalid and is resumed or replaced with the same seed; it is not a scientific observation.

measurements.primary_mechanism: Per-run fraction of prespecified replay checkpoints whose native-versus-intended normalized gradient cosine is <=0.99 and relative L2 difference is >=0.05 on the identical minibatch.
measurements.negative_control_equivalence: At least 95% of replay checkpoints have cosine >=0.999 and relative L2 difference <=0.01.
measurements.learning: Seed-paired held-out pass@1 learning-curve AUC at the common charged-token ceiling.
measurements.final_quality: Seed-paired held-out pass@1 at the common charged-token ceiling.
measurements.efficiency: Measured FLOPs and charged tokens to the intended_full median final-quality target.
measurements.useful_gradient: Fraction of charged completion tokens contributing nonzero finite gradient after the frozen treatment mask.

screening_gate.gradient_effect_metric: Within the intended_full trajectory, the native effect is the mean checkpoint cosine loss 1-cos(g_intended,g_native). Within each ablation trajectory, its selected-gradient effect is mean 1-cos(g_selected,g_intended). reduction_only reproduces the native effect when its seed-paired ratio is at least 0.80; epsilon_only must satisfy the negative-control cosine and relative-L2 margins at at least 95 of 100 steps.
screening_gate.learning_auc_formula: Trapezoidal pass@1 area over evaluation steps 0,20,40,60,80,100 divided by 100; condition differences are paired within regime and seed.
screening_gate.mechanism: In filtered_variable_length, all three seeds must have at least 20 of 100 replay checkpoints meeting both primary gradient-discrepancy thresholds; balanced_equal_length must satisfy the negative-control equivalence rule.
screening_gate.causal_attribution: reduction_only must reproduce at least 80% of the intended_full-versus-native_trl gradient-direction effect, while epsilon_only remains inside the negative-control equivalence margin.
screening_gate.learning: The intended_full-minus-native_trl AUC sign must be identical in all three seeds and the absolute paired standardized mean must be at least 0.5; final quality must remain within the task margin.
screening_gate.go: Advance only if mechanism, causal attribution, learning, provenance, and matched-compute clauses all pass.
screening_gate.kill: Stop the flagship training expansion if any clause fails; preserve S1 as a conformance artifact and do not spend the confirmatory matrix.

power.screening: Three seeds are a directional gate, not a confirmatory significance test; step-level checkpoints are summarized within run and never treated as independent replicates.
power.confirmatory: Before any confirmatory allocation, estimate paired power from the screening seed-level mean and standard deviation using 100000 Monte Carlo draws from numpy PCG64 seed 20260720, n=5, two-sided Holm-adjusted alpha=0.0125. Require at least 0.80 power for the pooled AUC effect and at least 0.80 TOST power at every task-specific final-quality margin; otherwise stop because the frozen five-seed design is underpowered.
power.equivalence: Equivalence claims require both gradient margins and the relevant task TOST to pass; a confidence interval crossing zero is INCONCLUSIVE.

analysis.independent_unit: training seed within a frozen condition/regime cell
analysis.pairing: Conditions are paired by seed, prompt order, initial adapter state, and replay minibatch.
analysis.primary_model: Seed-level paired regime-by-condition interaction; no checkpoint-level pseudo-replication.
analysis.multiplicity: Ordered gate for mechanism then causal attribution then learning; Holm correction applies only to confirmatory H1-H4 claims.
analysis.missingness: Intention-to-treat for scientific runs; infrastructure failures resume exact checkpoints and do not become observations.

provenance.local: Atomic full record with config, source hashes, token/FLOP ledger, per-step metrics, replay gradient summaries, checkpoints, and held-out evidence.
provenance.wandb: One finished immutable run per unit with condition, regime, seed, source fingerprint, and summary endpoints.
provenance.hugging_face: One private repository per unit with checkpoints 20/40/60/80/100, final adapter, byte-identical manifest, and held-out evidence.
provenance.acceptance: Local, W&B, and Hugging Face identities and hashes must agree before a unit is scientific evidence.

authorization.scope: One non-scientific A100 smoke first. Only a separately accepted smoke receipt unlocks the six corpus jobs; only an accepted matching corpus unlocks each four-condition scientific block. Maximum three concurrent Colab sessions. No confirmation jobs are authorized by this transition.
authorization.reason: The exact data/runtime/budget protocol, replay semantics, native/intended DAPO differentials, remote trainer, profiler ledger, checkpoint/evaluation recovery, independent W&B/Hugging Face verifier, go/kill analysis, and smoke-gated supervisor passed the offline gate.
